data.notes: January’s confirmed calendar is anchored by Phish’s MSG New Year’s run, NYC Winter Jazzfest, and Brooklyn’s early-year club programming across Pacha, SILO and Elsewhere.

events.title: Phish New Year’s Run at Madison Square Garden
events.summary: Phish closes its four-night Madison Square Garden New Year’s run with January 1 and January 2 performances; the January 2 show is billed as the band’s 100th performance at The Garden.

events.title: NYC Winter Jazzfest 2027
events.summary: The 2027 NYC Winter Jazzfest pass covers January 12–19 across 18 venues with 100+ bands. Confirmed artists include Sun Ra Arkestra, Brandee Younger, Marc Ribot, Ravi Coltrane, David Murray, Irreversible Entanglements, Aja Monet, and many more.

events.title: MERGE x THE GREAT BEYOND Weekender
events.summary: Brooklyn queer-techno institution MERGE teams with The Great Beyond for a five-day winter weekender, moving from experimental/live programming at Nowadays into East Williamsburg warehouse nights.

events.title: SOSA at Brooklyn Pacha
events.summary: Liverpool tech-house DJ SOSA headlines Brooklyn Pacha on New Year’s Weekend, with the venue billing the night as a 10 PM–4 AM club show.

events.title: Eli Escobar (Open to Close)
events.summary: NYC house mainstay Eli Escobar plays an open-to-close full-venue club night at Elsewhere, with doors listed at 10:30 PM.

events.title: Zomboy at SILO Brooklyn
events.summary: EMW presents bass-music headliner Zomboy at SILO Brooklyn for a 10 PM–4 AM 21+ nightclub show.

events.title: OMAR
events.summary: London deep-house artist Omar+ brings an extended set to Knockdown Center, blending house production with R&B-inspired vocals inside one of NYC’s key large-scale warehouse venues.

events.title: Bree Runway at Elsewhere
events.summary: British pop and rap artist Bree Runway is confirmed for The Hall at Elsewhere, with Bandsintown listing a 7 PM show.

events.title: Miss Bashful (Live) Full Venue Takeover
events.summary: Miss Bashful brings a live full-venue takeover to Elsewhere, with the venue listing doors at 10:30 PM for the 21+ club event.

events.title: TeeDee presents Hyperactive - All Night Long
events.summary: TeeDee brings the Hyperactive all-night-long format to SILO, with RA listing tech house and minimal for the 10 PM–4 AM club night.

events.title: corto.alto at Le Poisson Rouge
events.summary: Glasgow jazz project corto.alto is confirmed for Le Poisson Rouge, with RA listing a 6:30 PM–11 PM show.

events.title: HEYZ at SILO Brooklyn
events.summary: EMW Presents lists HEYZ at SILO Brooklyn from 10 PM on January 16 to 4 AM on January 17, adding another bass/electronic club booking to the month.

events.title: Medellin Fridays - Colombian Latin & Reggaeton Party NYC
events.summary: iBoatNYC’s Medellin Fridays returns on New Year’s Day at San Antonios, with RA listing the party as a Colombian Latin and reggaeton night running 5 PM–3 AM.

events.title: Medellin Fridays - Colombian Latin & Reggaeton Party NYC
events.summary: A Colombian-focused Latin and reggaeton party in the Lower East Side, promoted by iBoatNYC/Perreo Parrty and aimed at late-night diaspora dance-floor energy.
